title: UserGems Launches UserGems MCP, Research Agent, and New & Improved Writing Agent at UserGems Insiders
summary: UserGems launches MCP, Research Agent, and a new & improved Writing Agent at UserGems Insiders on September 15th 2026
body_markdown:
**UserGems Launches UserGems MCP, Research Agent, and New & Improved Writing Agent at UserGems Insiders**


*"Don't leave your GTM to chance": live session on September 15 brings the GTM brain to life, with playbooks from Frontify and Scrappy ABM, and $500 up for grabs for four winners to spend on something they've never done before*


**San Francisco, CA — \[September 9th 2026\]** UserGems, the AI command center for outbound and ABM, today announced UserGems Insiders, a live session on Tuesday, September 15, 2026 at 12:00 PM ET / 9:00 AM PT. The session marks the launch of UserGems MCP, Research Agent, and a new and improved Writing Agent, and opens "Don't leave your GTM to chance," the campaign running across all of UserGems' fall events.


**Pipeline shouldn't be a guessing game**


Most GTM teams are still betting on gut feel and hoping the odds land in their favor. UserGems Insiders makes the case that they don't have to. Connect UserGems to Claude or ChatGPT through UserGems MCP, and the AI acts on full context: it builds the campaign, scores the account, drafts the outreach, and syncs the ad audience. Prompt it once and it runs the play automatically. Less guessing, more knowing.


At UserGems Insiders, attendees get the full picture on the GTM brain: how to build an always-on pipeline engine, a first look at UserGems MCP alongside Research Agent and the new and improved Writing Agent, and real playbooks from teams already using UserGems for event outreach and GTM brain building.


**Speakers and agenda**


- **12:00–12:20 PM** — Welcome: latest market trends in AI GTM, and how to build and scale an AI brain, with Christian Kletzl, Co-founder & CEO, UserGems
- **12:20–12:40 PM** — Product: introducing UserGems MCP, Research Agent, and the new and improved Writing Agent, with Mackenzie Clements, Solutions Engineer, UserGems
- **12:40–1:00 PM** — Playbook: turning an AI brain into an always-on outbound and ABM engine, with Trinity Nguyen, CMO, UserGems
- **1:00–1:20 PM** — Playbook: "We have our own AI GTM brain. Here's how we boost it with UserGems," with Alex von Stegmann, GTM Strategy & Engineering, Frontify
- **1:20–1:40 PM** — Playbook: ABMify your events, with Mason Cosby, CEO & Founder, Scrappy ABM
- **1:40–1:45 PM** — Breakout rooms: ABM & ads, outbound, and UserGems product Q&A


Anyone who joins a post-session breakout room gets a coffee on UserGems, courtesy of Sendoso.


**The prizes**


Four winners will each receive $500, with one rule: spend it on something you've never done before. Winners will be announced on LinkedIn in the days following the session.


**Part of a bigger bet**


UG Insiders opens "Don't leave your GTM to chance," a campaign that carries the same look, feel, and message to UserGems at Pavilion NYC, OpStars, and Funnel London through October.


**Event details**


- **Date:** Tuesday, September 15, 2026
- **Time:** 12:00 PM ET / 9:00 AM PT
- **Format:** Live webinar
- **Register:**[usergems.com/webinars/insiders](https://www.usergems.com/webinars/insiders)


**About UserGems**


UserGems is the AI command center for outbound and ABM. We help sales and marketing capture buying signals, identify and prioritize the right buyers, then take the next actions to generate more pipeline at scale. For more information, visit[usergems.com](https://www.usergems.com/) .
